entries.title: Focus time, across your whole calendar
entries.entryOuterHTML:
September 9, 2026

Version 2.3

New

Focus time, across your whole calendar

Focus blocks now work everywhere you do. Schedule one in Forma and it appears in your calendar, pauses Forma notifications, and updates your chat status until you are done.

  • Set a default focus length and preferred hours in Settings → Focus.

  • Teammates see “Focusing until 12:00” on your avatar, so they know when you will be back.

  • End a block early and your notifications catch up in a single summary.

entries.title: Automation activity log
entries.entryOuterHTML:
August 26, 2026

Version 2.2

New

Improved

Automation activity log

Every automation now keeps a readable history. Open any rule to see each time it ran, what it changed, and the event that triggered it.

  • Undo any automated change straight from the log.

  • Rules that fail explain why and suggest a fix.

  • Automations run noticeably faster when several fire at once.

entries.title: Team Chat and File Storage integrations
entries.entryOuterHTML:
July 29, 2026

Version 2.1

New

Beta

Team Chat and File Storage integrations

Two of the most requested integrations are here in beta. Turn a team chat message into a task, and attach stored files to the projects they belong to.

  • Link a Teams channel to a project to share updates automatically.

  • Stored files show a live preview on the task.

entries.title: Small fixes and polish
entries.entryOuterHTML:
June 30, 2026

Version 2.0.4

Fixed

Small fixes and polish

Fixes for issues reported by customers.

  • Recurring tasks no longer duplicate when edited across time zones.

  • Calendar events with long titles now wrap instead of cutting off.

  • Keyboard focus stays in the command menu after searching.
